en.headline: Observatory says Hong Kong recorded its warmest October since 1884
en.dek: Mean maximum, mean and mean minimum temperatures all set October records, attributed to an extremely strong El Nino and other factors.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the city experienced its warmest October since records began in 1884. The mean maximum temperature was 30.5 degrees Celsius, the mean temperature 27.6 degrees and the mean minimum 25.8 degrees, all the highest for any October.

The Observatory attributed the warmth to climate warming, an extremely strong El Nino event, a weaker-than-normal northeast monsoon in October, and a stronger-than-normal anticyclone aloft over southern China.
The monthly weather summary was issued on 30 October, with further details expected in early November. Current forecasts point to mainly cloudy conditions with light rain patches in the coming days.

zh.headline: 天文台：香港經歷1884年以來最暖10月
zh.dek: 平均最高、平均及平均最低氣溫均打破歷來10月紀錄，天文台指與極強厄爾尼諾等有關。
body: 香港天文台表示，本港剛經歷自1884年有紀錄以來最暖的10月。平均最高氣溫30.5度、平均氣溫27.6度及平均最低氣溫25.8度，全部打破歷來10月最高紀錄。
天文台解釋，除氣候暖化外，現正處於極強的厄爾尼諾事件，加上10月東北季候風較正常弱，而影響華南的高空反氣旋較正常強，都是導致今次高溫的原因。
月報於10月30日發出，預計11月初會有進一步更新。目前展望未來數日大致多雲，間中有微雨。
